acceptanceCriteria: workspaceDirectories uses the strict reader, or a documented equivalent, and an input the strict reader refuses becomes uncertainty.
Maintained tests cover a go.work file both parsers previously read differently.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Found by the V1-0867 lane (branch claude/v1-0867-nested-frontier, d5128a48, base 3dc863bd). workspaceDirectories parses go.work use lines loosely, while the V1-0867 nested-module frontier reads go.mod and go.work with a strict reader that is never laxer than x/mod/modfile. Two parsers for one file format can disagree on the same input.

title: affected/golang: unify workspaceDirectories' loose go.work parser with the strict manifest reader from V1-0867
